newsitem.title: USA: Chart House to sell 3.4 mln shrs privately.
newsitem.headline: Chart House to sell 3.4 mln shrs privately.

text.p: Chart House Enterprises Inc said it would sell 3.4 million newly issued shares of common stock in a private placement to an affiliate of Equity Group Investments Inc at $5.75 per share for a total purchase price of $19.5 million.

Chart House said it has completed the sale of 1,641,750 shares for $9.4 million. An additional 1,758,250 shares will be sold for $10.1 million, subject to obtaining prior approval of Chart House stockholders at a meeting expected to be held in May. Chart House intends to use the net proceeds, after transaction costs, to repay existing indebtedness.
